arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission/src/de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, pathlib
base = pathlib.Path('frame')
# varint-valued ModifiableInteger fields per file (field names)
targets = {
 'DataBlockedFrame.java': ['maximumData'],
 'DatagramFrame.java': ['length'],
 'MaxDataFrame.java': ['maximumData'],
 'MaxStreamDataFrame.java': ['streamId','maximumStreamData'],
 'MaxStreamsFrame.java': ['maximumStreams'],
 'ResetStreamFrame.java': ['streamId','applicationProtocolErrorCode','finalSize'],
 'RetireConnectionIdFrame.java': ['sequenceNumber'],
 'StopSendingFrame.java': ['streamId','applicationProtocolErrorCode'],
 'StreamDataBlockedFrame.java': ['streamId','maximumStreamData'],
 'StreamFrame.java': ['streamId','offset','length'],
 'StreamsBlockedFrame.java': ['maximumStreams'],
}
for fn, fields in targets.items():
    p = base/fn
    s = p.read_text()
    s = s.replace('import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.integer.ModifiableInteger;',
                  'import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.longint.ModifiableLong;')
    for f in fields:
        cap = f[0].upper()+f[1:]
        s = s.replace('protected ModifiableInteger %s;'%f, 'protected ModifiableLong %s;'%f)
        s = s.replace('public ModifiableInteger get%s()'%cap, 'public ModifiableLong get%s()'%cap)
        s = s.replace('public void set%s(ModifiableInteger %s)'%(cap,f), 'public void set%s(ModifiableLong %s)'%(cap,f))
        s = s.replace('public void set%s(int %s)'%(cap,f), 'public void set%s(long %s)'%(cap,f))
        s = s.replace('this.%s = ModifiableVariableFactory.safelySetValue(this.%s, (long) %s);'%(f,f,f),
                      'this.%s = ModifiableVariableFactory.safelySetValue(this.%s, %s);'%(f,f,f))
        s = s.replace('this.%s =\n                ModifiableVariableFactory.safelySetValue(this.%s, (long) %s);'%(f,f,f),
                      'this.%s = ModifiableVariableFactory.safelySetValue(this.%s, %s);'%(f,f,f))
        # config fields
        s = s.replace('private int %sConfig;'%f, 'private long %sConfig;'%f)
        s = s.replace('this.%sConfig = %sConfig;'%(f,f), 'this.%sConfig = %sConfig;'%(f,f))
        s = s.replace('public int get%sConfig()'%cap, 'public long get%sConfig()'%cap)
        s = s.replace('public void set%sConfig(int %sConfig)'%(cap,f), 'public void set%sConfig(long %sConfig)'%(cap,f))
    p.write_text(s)
    print('rewrote', fn)
PYEOF
